title: Rabbi Huna bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Midrash Tehillim 104:14 for a dispute with Rabbi Simon, and the end of Bereshit Rabbah chapter 68 for a teaching that Rabbi Pinchas reports in Huna’s name. He also cites Kohelet Rabbah, chapter 2, on the verse beginning “and the advantage.”

notes.text: The printed ק״ד is 104. The consulted Midrash Tehillim 104:14 does not contain this dispute, so its precise location remains unresolved.

The saved whole OYW Midrash Tehillim104 stork paragraph names Huna bar Pappa and Yehudah in Simon’s name, followed by two views. It supplies a corresponding discussion while differing from Hyman’s compressed “disputing with Simon” account. It does not establish that Hyman’s104:14 is that edition’s exact section numbering. The older bounded104:14 nonmatch is preserved, not generalized into absence from the work.

The consulted Midrash Tehillim 104 names Rabbi Huna bar Papa and Rabbi Yehudah reporting in Rabbi Simon’s name in the stork discussion, then gives two opinions without saying which belongs to whom. In the consulted Bereshit Rabbah 68, Pinchas reports Huna’s teaching at the opening. Kohelet Rabbah 5:8 names Huna bar Papa in a discussion of sacrifices before the Tabernacle under “and the advantage of the land.” Hyman’s print (vol. I, pp. 356–357) gives the chapter and section numbers retained in the translation.
